dcterms:description: The dataset for the SemEval-2021 Task 2: Multilingual and Cross-lingual Word-in-Context Disambiguation, which includes training, development, and test subsets for multiple languages, containing unique IDs, target lemmas, parts of speech, and sentences with indices of target words.
dcterms:title: SemEval-2021 Task 2 Dataset
